title: MODE 5: REG (Paired-Variable Regression)
summary: Enter (x, y) pairs with x , y DT, press AC, then recall coefficients A, B (and C for Quad) and r from S-VAR.

body.text: MODE 5 (REG) stores paired samples and fits one regression model. A REG indicator appears. In REG the M+ key becomes DT (data register). You cannot use independent memory M+ here — every DT stores an (x, y) pair instead.

body.title: Regression models (pick one before entering data)

body.text: Switching into REG from another mode clears statistical memory automatically. If you are already in REG with an old list, clear before a new question:
SHIFT 9 is CLR; item 1 is Stat. Leaving REG for COMP, CMPLX, BASE, or PRGM also clears the list.
After MODE 5, the calculator shows a regression menu. Only 1–4 appear on the first screen. Press ▶ (RIGHT) for a second screen with Inv, Quad, and AB-Exp.
You can also switch type later with SHIFT 2 → 3 (TYPE) while still in REG.
After MODE 5 and your regression type, enter each pair as x , y DT. The comma is the key between 0 and EXP (same as SD frequency separator). DT is the blue M+ key in REG.

Line = on the display counts stored pairs. Scroll with ▲ / ▼ to review. When every pair is entered, press AC once to leave the editor — then recall results with S-VAR. Recalling coefficients while still browsing the list often gives wrong values.
Same SETUP option as [[modes/sd]]. FreqOn (default): x , y DT counts once, or x , y ; f DT repeats that pair f times. FreqOff: only x , y DT — using ; gives Syntax ERROR.
After AC, SHIFT 2 opens S-VAR. Press 1 for the VAR submenu, then ▶ to move to later screens. Each child page lists the recalls for its model. In general:

items: SHIFT 2 → 1 → ▶ → ▶: A (1), B (2), r or C (3) — on Quad, item 3 is C (no r)
Estimate ŷ from x: type x, then SHIFT 2 → 1 → ◀ item 2 (Lin/Log/Exp/Pwr/Inv/AB-Exp) or ◀ item 3 (Quad)
Estimate x from y: type y, then SHIFT 2 → 1 → ◀ item 1 (Lin/Log/Exp/Pwr/Inv/AB-Exp); Quad has two x̂ values on ◀ 1 and ◀ 2

body.text: SHIFT 1 (S-SUM) recalls Σx, Σy, n, Σx², Σxy, and other sums used internally. SHIFT 2 → 3 (TYPE) switches regression type without entering VAR.

items: Lin, Log, Exp, Pwr, Inv, AB-Exp: at least 2 (x, y) pairs
Quad: at least 3 (x, y) pairs (three coefficients A, B, C)
FreqOn: up to 26 stored records; FreqOff: up to 40
Data Full if you exceed the limit — delete rows or collapse repeats with FreqOn
Wrong model (e.g. Lin on curved data) can still show a moderate r — pick the shape that matches the scatter

body.text: Viewing, editing, and deleting pairs matches [[modes/sd]]: ▲/▼ to browse, type a new value and EXE to replace (do not press DT), SHIFT DT (CL) to delete the displayed pair. Press MODE 1 when finished with statistics.
